chunks: And say: 'All praise be to God. He will show you His signs, and you will recognise them. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that God will show us His signs and recognize them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the dynamic nature of divine signs (ayat), which are not merely historical miracles but ongoing manifestations of God’s power in creation and history that lead to recognition (ma'arif). It connects the act of praising God with the certainty of accountability, emphasizing that divine revelation is paired with omniscience regarding human deeds. This reinforces the Shia concept of 'Adl (Divine Justice), where God’s knowledge of actions directly informs the eventual revelation of signs and subsequent judgment.
